Read the following passage and answer the question by choosing the best option. Provide only the text of the correct option as your answer.

Passage: (CNN) Long-term use of acetaminophen during pregnancy was associated with twice the risk of attention-deficit hyperactivity disorder in children, according to a study published Monday in the journal Pediatrics. However, two experts believe that the data do not support these findings. Acetaminophen, also known as paracetamol, is the active ingredient in Tylenol and hundreds of over-the-counter and prescription medicines, according to the US Food and Drug Administration. It is commonly prescribed during pregnancy to relieve pain and fever, with an estimated 65% of pregnant women in America using the drug, according to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
@highlight
Researchers collected data from about 95,000 mothers with children born between 1999 and 2009
@highlight
Long-term acetaminophen use in pregnancy is related to more than a twofold increase in risk for ADHD in children
@highlight
The data does not support their conclusions, other experts say
Query: No evidence of a cause-effect relationship between the drug and @placeholder was found, Ystrøm and his colleagues concluded.

Options : A. US Food and Drug Administration
B. Acetaminophen
C. Long
D. Pediatrics
E. America
F. Tylenol
G. ADHD
H. US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the contetn of the correct option.
